content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: This PPN applies only to central government departments, their executive agencies and non-departmental public bodies. Such bodies are referred to as “in-scope organisations”.
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: Private utilities should strongly consider applying this PPN and accompanying guidance in relevant procurements in energy infrastructure, and engage with the Sector Lead on their proposed approach to relevant procurements.
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: Other organisations that are contracting authorities under the Procurement Act 2023 can consider their own pipelines in the context of the guidance. Where procurements are high value, complex or related to national interests, they are also encouraged to engage the Sector Leads.
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: The government’s National Security Strategy 2025 is clear that we are entering a new era of radical uncertainty and that a major cultural shift is needed for the UK to respond effectively. To ensure public procurement plays its part, the government is taking action to recalibrate its approach so that the UK’s huge purchasing power is more effectively deployed to protect our national security.
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: In this PPN, the government has commissioned action in four critical sectors and identified organisations to act as Sector Leads for each:
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: shipbuilding - National Shipbuilding Office, Ministry of Defence
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: steel - Department for Business and Trade
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: artificial intelligence - Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: energy infrastructure - Department of Energy Security and Net Zero
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: PPN 025: Protecting the UK’s national security through public procurement
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: To identify the procurements in the pipeline relevant to protecting the UK’s national security in shipbuilding, steel, artificial intelligence and energy infrastructure and engage early with the relevant Sector Lead to ensure the commercial approach protects the UK’s national security interests.
